## History

Silas Sloane is mentioned as part of the history surrounding [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's forgotten garden. According to [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) married Silas Sloane and subsequently moved away to live with him.
